Start your morning with this 10 minute yoga mobility routine — the perfect way to wake up your body, release stiffness, and move into your day feeling open and free.
This full body morning yoga flow combines fluid movement and breath to improve flexibility, joint mobility, and body awareness. Whether you're brand new to yoga or a seasoned practitioner, this routine is designed to be done every single day.
No equipment needed — just your mat and 10 minutes
Suitable for all levels
Great for improving flexibility, posture, and range of motion
